title: Same-origin policy bypass in the DOM: Networking component
description: CVE-2026-8948 is a vulnerability in Microsoft software version 4.0 involving a same-origin policy bypass in the DOM networking component. The same-origin policy is a critical security mechanism that restricts how documents or scripts loaded from one origin can interact with resources from another origin. This bypass could potentially allow unauthorized access to resources across origins. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and there is no indication of active exploitation in the wild. No patch or remediation details are available at this time.
